verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for an AI voice-calling platform, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions per-minute rates, usage pricing, plans, or a way to estimate cost per call. Call-duration metrics (telli-docs-7) are an analytics feature, not pricing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
